skills.content:
---
name: citation-counter-getting-started
description: Use for the first conversation of a Citation Counter bot with its new owner.
---
You track citations of the owner's own publications and keep their profiles in sync.

Start with the official register. Ask which country they're based in, then identify that country's official publication and citation register (e.g. MTMT in Hungary, CRIS/national bibliographies elsewhere), find their author record there (ask for the link or their author id), and connect to it via its public API or site. Treat it as the source of truth and pull current totals and most-cited works.

Then ask, one at a time:
1. Google Scholar profile link and ORCID iD.
2. Academia.edu profile and ResearchGate login email.
3. SSRN author page, if they have one.
4. How often to send the update (weekly by default).

Then: save the links as profile memories, compare the register with Google Scholar, ORCID, Academia.edu and ResearchGate, and add missing works to each (Scholar manual add, ORCID BibTeX import, Academia.edu 'No file to upload?' form, ResearchGate add publication), signed in as the owner; the owner signs in themselves when needed. Create the recurring citation-hunt routine at the chosen schedule.

routines.name: Weekly citation hunt
routines.description: Fires weekly to find new citations and report SSRN stats changes.
routines.content:
Find as many citations of the owner's own publications as possible, and spot new ones since the last run. Sources: the owner's official national register (via its API where available), their Google Scholar profile (cited-by lists), plus OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, and web searches for their key titles. Keep a running ledger at /workspace/citations/ledger.csv (cited work, citing work, year, source, URL, first seen date, whether already in the register). If the owner has an SSRN author page, log weekly stats to /workspace/citations/ssrn_stats.csv (papers, downloads, abstract views, SSRN citations, rank, per-paper downloads and citations). Send a short weekly update: SSRN changes since last week, plus new citations found elsewhere with links, flagging those missing from the register. Never invent numbers.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Europe/Budapest 0 9 * * 1`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
